title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: July 27, 2026 – Free Agency Heats Up, Major Trades Reshape Landscape

items.headline: LeBron James Officially Signs with Philadelphia 76ers
items.summary: In the biggest move of the offseason, LeBron James has officially signed a two-year, $8 million contract with the Philadelphia 76ers, including a player option for the second season. This monumental decision, heavily influenced by Philly's acquisition of Jaylen Brown, sees James chasing a fifth championship in a loaded Eastern Conference.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Traded to Miami Heat in Blockbuster Deal
items.summary: Two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo has been traded to the Miami Heat. The Milwaukee Bucks received Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakučionis, the No. 13 pick in the 2026 draft, first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, and a 2030 pick swap, and a 2033 second-round pick in return.

items.headline: Celtics Trade Jaylen Brown to 76ers
items.summary: The Boston Celtics have traded All-NBA forward Jaylen Brown to the Philadelphia 76ers, concluding weeks of speculation. This significant move was a key factor in LeBron James' decision to join Philadelphia.

items.headline: Hawks Acquire Lu Dort in Three-Team Deal
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks have acquired guard Lu Dort and Ryan Nembhard in a three-team trade involving the OKC Thunder and DAL Mavericks. Dallas received Zaccharie Risacher, while Oklahoma City gained three future second-round picks.

items.headline: Lakers Send Deandre Ayton to Washington Wizards
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers are continuing their frontcourt reshuffle by sending center Deandre Ayton to the Washington Wizards. This trade follows their post-LeBron retooling efforts.

items.headline: Russell Westbrook Faces Uncertainty in Free Agency
items.summary: Former MVP Russell Westbrook is reportedly generating very little interest in free agency and could begin the 2026-27 season without a contract. The 37-year-old spent last season with the SAC Kings, averaging 15.2 points and 6.7 assists.

items.headline: Mario Hezonja Returns to NBA, Signs with Cavaliers
items.summary: Croatian forward Mario Hezonja is making his NBA return, agreeing to a one-year, $2.8 million contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers. He activated his NBA clause with Real Madrid to join the Cavs.

items.headline: Mike Conley Joins Boston Celtics
items.summary: Veteran guard Mike Conley will begin his 20th NBA season with the Boston Celtics, signing a one-year veteran minimum deal.

items.headline: Golden State Warriors Crowned Summer League Champions
items.summary: The 2026 NBA Las Vegas Summer League has concluded, with the Golden State Warriors defeating the Memphis Grizzlies in the championship game. Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg, the 10th overall pick, was named Summer League MVP.

items.headline: Kyle Lowry Announces Retirement After 20 Seasons
items.summary: NBA veteran and 2019 champion Kyle Lowry has announced his retirement from professional basketball after 20 seasons. Lowry was the last active player from the 2006 NBA Draft.

items.headline: Garrett Temple Hired as Mavericks Assistant Coach
items.summary: After a 17-year playing career with 12 teams, Garrett Temple has been hired as an assistant coach for the Dallas Mavericks.
